Identical warning line appearing twice in the source (once with a preceding sentence, once alone) is translated identically both times; not an error, not merged.

Female/male sentence-final particles (わよ / ぜ, 俺) are grammatical gender markers on the speaker's own speech only; no third-party pronoun or identity was invented from them, matching BASE_RULES on not inferring gender from context that isn't stated.
